newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Compal issues $95 mln bonds abroad.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Compal issues $95 mln bonds abroad.

text.p: Taiwan computer and monitor maker Compal Electronics Inc said on Tuesday it has completed overseas roadshows and raised US$95 million in convertible bonds for purchasing materials.
"Due to active demand, we raised a total of US$95 million, higher than our original plan of US$85 million," Compal spokesman Lu Ching-hsiung told Reuters by telephone.

The seven-year convertible bonds have a coupon rate of 1.0 percent, with a put-option right in the fifth year whose yield to put is set at five-year U.S. Treasury bond yield plus 100 basis points, or 7.13 percent, Lu said.
The conversion price, at a premium of 9.945 percent, will be T$62.5, he said.
The convertibles will be listed in Luxembourg.
Compal also plans a domestic rights issue of 70 million common shares in December with an underwriting price of T$25 per share, Lu said.
The rights issue will raise T$1.75 billion for Compal, of which T$150 million will be used to expand notebook computer production and T$1.6 billion for normal operations, he said.
